process_input_messages_string_prompt: process input messages by applying guardrails to a single string prompt for OpenAI text completion
process_input_messages_batch_prompts: process input messages by applying guardrails to a list of string prompts for batch OpenAI text completion
process_output_response_choices: process output response by applying guardrails to completion text across multiple response choices
process_input_messages_no_prompt: process input messages that contain no prompt and return the original request data unchanged
process_output_response_no_choices: process output response with no choices and return the response unchanged
